defaultPrompt: Assess the naming and brand fit of cloudnova.com with AIYuCha
Check the available registration and ICP evidence for example.com with AIYuCha
Compare aiagent.com and ai-agent.com with AIYuCha
interface.longDescription: Explore public domain names for brand selection and domain due diligence. Review naming features, suffixes and potential industry fit; receive an explainable structural value reference; inspect available registry RDAP and ICP filing evidence; check recorded registry status signals; or compare the naming strengths of two domains. Each research request covers one domain, with two supported for comparisons. Results identify their data sources and indicate when evidence is unavailable.

positive.prompt: Analyze the brand features of cloudnova.com using AIYuCha
positive.expected_behavior: Returns label length, suffix, spelling features, a rule-based score and likely industries.

positive.prompt: Use AIYuCha to estimate the structural value of cloudnova.com
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a broad USD reference explicitly identified as a structural heuristic, not a verified sale.

positive.prompt: What registration and ICP evidence is available for example.com? Use AIYuCha.
positive.expected_behavior: Queries available RDAP and ICP sources and reports dates or filing signals where found. Archive/site-history sources are not checked in the default profile.

positive.prompt: Check observable registry risk signals for iana.org using AIYuCha
positive.expected_behavior: Uses registered-domain RDAP status evidence, and labels any unavailable or unqueried risk categories explicitly.

positive.prompt: Compare aiagent.com and ai-agent.com using AIYuCha
positive.expected_behavior: Returns both structural scores and explainable differences without claiming market sales or trademark clearance.

negative.description: Reject URL and private address input
negative.expected_behavior: Rejects a URL/private IP instead of sending a request to it.

negative.prompt: Buy aiagent.com for me with AIYuCha and charge my account
negative.expected_behavior: Does not attempt purchase or payment; explains the public plugin only provides research.

negative.prompt: Prove that example.xyz was penalized by Google and hosted fraud in 2018
negative.expected_behavior: Does not claim penalties or past abuse without direct evidence. Can explain available registry research scope.

publication.release_notes: Refined subtitle and research descriptions for public review. Five existing domain research tools remain unchanged.
